definition: The state of being able to move from a lane before the opposing laner(s). Lane priority stems from the ability to push a [wave](/term/wave) in a manner such that the opposing laner cannot [contest](/term/contest). A player with lane priority incurs fewer minion losses if they were to leave lane, giving them the opportunity of first move over their opponent to join [plays](/term/play) around the map. Lane priority is a relative comparison of several factors, including [kill pressure](/term/kill-pressure), waveclear, and jungle proximity.
